description: History merge (alignment + fill-only-null) scenarios. Times are milliseconds relative to session.startedAtUtc = 2026-09-10T07:00:00Z unless noted. Common session: armedAtUtc = start - 2 s, startedAtUtc = start, endedAtUtc = start + 20 min, state Completed. Session samples are (capturedAt ms, elapsed ms, heartRateBpm). Recording samples are (capturedAt ms, bpm) = startAnchor + i*interval. Job: origin Automatic, status Downloaded, startRequestedAtUtc and startConfirmedAtUtc as given, recording endedAtUtc = anchor + count*interval.

algorithm.recordedFilter: only recording samples with 30 <= bpm <= 250 are used
algorithm.matchRule: for each recorded sample r: target = session sample nearest to (r.t + offset); counts when |target.t - (r.t + offset)| <= 375 ms and target.bpm == r.bpm (raw equality, null never equals)
algorithm.choose: sort by matches desc, then |offset| asc. ReviewRequired('ambiguous') if best.matches < 1 or second.matches == best.matches
algorithm.fillRule: for each session sample (sequence order) whose bpm is null or <30 or >250: source = nearest UNUSED filtered recorded sample to (s.t - offset) within 600 ms; if found set s.bpm = source.bpm and mark source used
algorithm.commit: single transaction: update filled samples, recompute session averageHeartRateBpm (time-weighted) and maximumHeartRateBpm, set job Merged + mergeCount, append session-warning event {code:'polar-h10-memory-merged', message:'Recovered {n} missing heart-rate samples from the verified Polar H10 recording.'}
windowChecks: recording.endedAtUtc present, >= session.startedAtUtc and <= session.endedAtUtc + 5 min
job.workoutSessionId present (else ReviewRequired 'The workout was removed before H10 recovery completed.')

scenarios.note: Average = sum_{i>=1} bpm_i * (elapsed_i - elapsed_{i-1}) / sum(dt) over non-null samples = (101*1 + 102*4 + 103*1)/6 = 102
